We are now interested in the following fundamental functions of sets
(figures) on the plane: translation, scaling (stretching or shrinking) reflec -
tion about the axes, and rotation about the origin. A handy tool for investi -
gating all of these (with the exception of translation) is a certain construct
called matrices, which we will study in the next section.
First, observe what is meant by a function F :  

the input of the function is a point of the plane and the output is also a point
on the plane.
